FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Fire Support Importing
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Allows custom fire supports to be imported or exported, just like units and squads.

patchNoteLines.li: Allows custom fire supports to be imported or exported. Uses same design as unit and squad import/export

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Settlement Description Update
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: Changes how settlement descriptions are created to let specific settlement types specify their own descriptions, e.g. orbital settlements having more space-themed descriptions.

patchNoteLines.li: Generate settlement descriptions based on optional new descriptionKey on WorldSettlementDef
Bugfix: when the player has the Militaristic policy and builds an Orbital settlement, a barracks building is added, even though barracks cannot be built on orbital settlements

FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.label: Orbital Settlement Fixes
FactionColonies.PatchNoteDef.description: A handful of fixes related to orbital settlements.

patchNoteLines.li: Bugfix: ReturnTicksToArrive() doesn't properly handle cross-layer pathfinding
Add canBeRaided and supportsManualBattle fields to WorldSettlementDef
Add virtual CanBeRaidedByFaction function to SettlementTypeExtension, allowing settlements to determine what kinds of factions can attack them. Defaults true
Use the new fields/functions to make Orbital Settlements raidable only by factions with Spacer tech or above. Orbital Settlements also do not support manual battles
